messages:
megan (product): Launch note: starting a small Private residency pilot next week for 10 customers. Purpose: validate routing controls and the per-tenant residency toggle. Docs + pilot agreement link will go out today.

owen (cs): Need a brief email template + checklist for CSMs. APAC customers want nighttime windows.

samir (security): For residency toggle: default is localized routing only; enabling cross-region fallback requires explicit opt-in and a signed attestation. We'll provide cert rotation guidance if they opt in.

tara (eng-ops): Rollout plan: invite Monday, onboarding calls Wed/Thu, staggered canary (2 tenants), expand if metrics good. Devops will expose `residency.status` and `route.fallback_allowed` metrics.

omegan (product): Important: telemetry remains off by default for air-gapped installs. We'll list the commands to enable monitoring in the runbook.

owen (cs): Please include short support script. We need a one-liner customers can paste to enable fallback after their sign-off.

tara (eng-ops): Adding snippet: `redwoodctl tenancy update --id <TENANT_ID> --set routing.residency=fallback_allowed` (customer must provide signed attestation first).

samir (security): Also publish the attestation template. Remind customers that enabling fallback changes data handling rules and may require legal review.

owen (cs): Great. I'll prep the email and P0 support rota for the window. Who approves the final copy?

omegan (product): Product + Legal sign-off. I'll post the confluence link when ready and tag Legal.

zendesk-bot: Pilot invites queued: residency-pilot-2026-10. Reminder: collect signed attestations within 7 days.
